claims.name: tests-ran-twice
claims.risk: the tests did not run twice in a container, the last run did not pass, or the last run tested source that is not the source the run left (a stale copy baked into an image)

claims.name: one-image-build
claims.risk: an image was built more than once although no dependency file changed: the changed tree was baked into a new image for a run

claims.name: nothing-left-running
claims.risk: a container the run started is still running when the run ends

claims.name: only-the-fix-and-container-files-changed
claims.risk: a file other than the fixed module and the container files of the project changed, such as a test

claims.name: stub-engine-only
claims.risk: a command reached a container engine other than the one the run was given: a docker program by its path, a changed PATH or engine variable, or another engine's command
